summary: 💬 New mod **QuanChat** makes chat easier to follow, with shout by default, sticky channels and a chat window that fades instead of vanishing.
🐔 **QuanPieces** adds a Floor Heater that decides whether eggs on Quan's Chicken Coop Floors hatch, and removes the Unheated Chicken Coop Floor.
🗺️ **QuanChunkLoader** no longer turns the map's dot-pin filter back on when observers are shown, and adds more Debug log checks for servers.

bullets: Showing observers on the map no longer turns the dot-pin filter back on.
Debug logging now also watches tames, owner changes, ships, overdue plants and station capacity.
Readme and changelog fixes only, with no change to the mod.
New Unheated Chicken Coop Floor, so eggs laid on it don't hatch and can be collected.
New Floor Heater (5 Stone, Workbench) warms coop floors within 10 m so eggs hatch, and needs no fuel.
Chicken Coop Floors are now warm only near a heater that's on, so existing coops need one to keep hatching eggs.
The Unheated Chicken Coop Floor is removed, and any placed ones disappear.

steps.label: new · 1.0.0
bullets: Adds chat you don't miss: shout by default, sticky /s and /say channels, no forced capitals, a fading chat window and no shout map pings.
